statement: The source method changed from Historic England NHLE v02 Listed Building polygons FeatureServer layer 3 exact-record querying to the Historic England Open Data Hub ArcGIS Hub Downloads API filtered static GeoJSON distribution for unused ListEntry 1239561 (Nos. 161 and 163 Magdalen Road). The official NHLE record establishes explicit detached-villa type evidence and Historic England metadata establishes listed-building polygon/area_ha semantics, but both filtered Hub download endpoints were inaccessible before any feature payload was returned.
